notes.title: New update is live!
notes.content:
These update includes the following changes:

-Camera collision improved
-Issues related to the "no returning to hub" unlockable are fixed
-You can't swim anymore in space by jumping from a specific location in L3
-"Under 40 secs cube" Ach-II-vement time is now stored before the cinematic
-Some hardcoded text has also been fixed
-You can't reactivate the first fight with Fat the Cat if you don't collect the cube and reenter the battle arena again
-If you carry a marble and then get hit the marble will not disappear anymore
-And issue where you could get stuck in a catapult on rage mode has been fixed
-Some issues when navigating the main menu have been fixed
-You can't activate the race by talking to the statue again if the Cube isn't collected
-When catapulting on the top of the level in L1 you can't glitch throw the cage and fall down the pit
-There isn't a cloned platform in challenge 4 anymore
-Collision with some scenery elements has been improved
-Rotation of the platforms to go up the white structure on L1 has been smoothed out

notes.title: Update with a bunch of bugs fixed and some added features
notes.content:
-Now you can do a U turn while swimming if you press the Freeze key
-The stats now display the time in minutes and seconds
-Now R has more oxygen while underwater
-Signs indicating the location of the cubes have now text

-Fixed - In some rare cases R was wallsliding against nothing
-Fixed - You could easily get into the salamander sanctuary without exploding the wall
-Fixed - In some rare cases R could get stuck in the teleporter
-Fixed - When landing in some specific platforms R turned into a Giant
-Fixed - The first person view has now the same behavior as the main camera
-Fixed - Logolo could punch you out of Sunshine Valley
-Fixed - Pontus in some cases would not fight back
-Fixed - application would hang if you die by falling at the same time a timer is running out
-Fixed - Some issues with the scenery where R could get stuck
-Fixed - If timed correctly, while sliding you could walk under water
-Fixed - Now you can hit trees in Rage Mode
-Fixed - Dying inside the labyrinth on L2 while the camera was set to Manual caused the cam to misbehave
-Fixed - You could talk to someone while in Close Cam
-Fixed - The Ornithologist on L3 could give you the Green Pigcoin without completing the task
-Fixed - Transparent cubes in L1 are now ignored by the camera
-Fixed - Collecting a guinea pig, dying and retrying the same level would not allow to complete the sidequest

notes.title: New juicy update - Custom joystick maps, Freeze Snap options, FN Button and much more!
notes.content:
So here is some info regarding the last update:

[list]
    [*]Customize Joystick map option in the Launcher
    [*]Option to change the behavior of the camera UP/DOWN axis to Zoom IN/OUT instead (in-game Menu)
    [*]Option to Snap R to the camera view (or the Camera to R) when triggering the Freeze Ray (in-game Menu) 
    [*]Option to lock the mouse to the window (in-game Menu)
    [*]Option to invert the axis of the Close view Camera (in-game Menu) 
    [*]Introducing the FN button (by default the Left Trigger on the Xbox controller and the Shift key on PC).
[list]
    [*]If you press this button while moving the camera up and down you will get the inverted effect of the option selected in (Cam Y Zoom).
    [*]If you hold it while pressing the Freeze button R will Snap to the camera view
    [*]You can also use it for swimming freeing up your right hand to move the cam
[/list]
    [*]Now if you are crawling and press the Jump button R will roll up and stand up quickly
    [*]Somersault angle has been increased so it does not accidentally trigger so easily.
    [*]Added a teleport midway to be used as a checkpoint for the Fat the Cat first fight 
[*]Now the cam reset button resets the Height too
[*]The planetoids in Challenge 5 have been put even closer
[*]Exploding enemies will not explode with a kick so it´s easier to grab them
[*]And last but no least a considerable amount of bug fixes :)

[/list]

tags.feature: Customize Joystick map option in the Launcher
Option to change the behavior of the camera UP/DOWN axis to Zoom IN/OUT instead (in-game Menu)
Option to Snap R to the camera view (or the Camera to R) when triggering the Freeze Ray (in-game Menu)
Option to lock the mouse to the window (in-game Menu)
Option to invert the axis of the Close view Camera (in-game Menu)
Introducing the FN button (by default the Left Trigger on the Xbox controller and the Shift key on PC).
If you press this button while moving the camera up and down you will get the inverted effect of the option selected in (Cam Y Zoom).
If you hold it while pressing the Freeze button R will Snap to the camera view
You can also use it for swimming freeing up your right hand to move the cam
Now if you are crawling and press the Jump button R will roll up and stand up quickly

tags.balance_change: Somersault angle has been increased so it does not accidentally trigger so easily.

tags.feature: Added a teleport midway to be used as a checkpoint for the Fat the Cat first fight
Now the cam reset button resets the Height too

tags.balance_change: The planetoids in Challenge 5 have been put even closer
Exploding enemies will not explode with a kick so it´s easier to grab them

tags.bug: And last but no least a considerable amount of bug fixes :)

-Fixed a platform on L4 where R triggers the "falling" animation when touching it
-Fixed a issue where players were able to reach the cube "up there somwhere" without activating the pots
-Fixed a collision issue with a Transparent Tower on the "up there somwhere"
